system.description:
FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Mind Points

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise. Adopted from Project FU's Chanter counterpart.)

CHANTER SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000064]{Magichant} 【Max SL 10】

Action, once per turn: spend MP to sing a verse — a volume (low 10 MP: one creature who can hear you; medium 20: every ally who can hear; high 30: every enemy who can hear) combined with a key (eight, each tied to a damage type, status, Attribute and recovery) and a tone (seven general effects). First level learns all three volumes plus one key and one tone; each further level adds a key or a tone.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000065]{Resonance} 【Max SL 3】

After your verse affects one or more enemies, with an arcane weapon equipped, choose one until the start of your next turn: allies deal (SL) extra damage to those enemies; or you recover (SL) MP each time one of them suffers damage (per enemy, when one source hits several).

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000066]{Sound Barrier} 【Max SL 5】

After you sing a verse at medium or high volume, all physical damage you suffer until the start of your next turn is reduced by (SL), applied before Affinities.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000067]{Vibrato}

After you sing a verse at low or medium volume, perform a free attack with an equipped weapon once the verse resolves, treating your High Roll as 0 for damage.
